name: memory-system-implementation
details: Implement the complete evolutionary memory system combining Memory System 2.0 (Refined) and 3.0 (Evolution) into CLAUDE.md and restructure the memory files to support learning across sessions.

tasks.name: Update CLAUDE.md Memory Section
tasks.details: Replace the current memory section in CLAUDE.md with comprehensive guide including: Core Philosophy (memory preserves what matters + enables learning), What Goes in Memory (surprises, facts, deferred tasks, etc.), Three Memory Zones, Session Lifecycle Workflow, Memory Format Rules, Evolution Mechanisms, Emoji Freedom, and Key Principles

sub_tasks.name: Write Core Philosophy
sub_tasks.details: Document that memory preserves what matters across sessions AND enables evolutionary learning - not just storage but active knowledge refinement

sub_tasks.name: Document What Goes in Memory
sub_tasks.details: List all types: surprises, important facts, deferred tasks, reminders, partial progress, contextual breadcrumbs. Include the test: 'Is this worth preserving across sessions?'

sub_tasks.name: Explain Three Memory Zones
sub_tasks.details: Document the three zones: Plan (via PlanAndTrack), Short-term memory (active discoveries + handoff), Long-term memory (enduring wisdom)

sub_tasks.name: Write Session Lifecycle Workflow
sub_tasks.details: Document SESSION START (read, plan, clear space), DURING SESSION (immediate capture in Quick Notes), and SESSION END (reflect, promote, prune, handoff)

sub_tasks.name: Add Memory Format Rules
sub_tasks.details: One line = one atomic memory (1-3 sentences), no human formatting, Claude's notepad not a document, self-contained clarity

sub_tasks.name: Document Evolution Mechanisms
sub_tasks.details: Search before add, update in place, annotate evolution, consolidate related, prune obsolete. Show knowledge evolution example

sub_tasks.name: Add Emoji Freedom Section
sub_tasks.details: Give 2-3 examples then emphasize ANY emoji can be used for creative expression. Different projects need different markers

tasks.name: Restructure long-term.md
tasks.details: Replace MCP-specific sections with universal categories that apply to any project

sub_tasks.name: Add universal sections

sub_tasks.name: Add extensibility note
